$comment: Industrial Platform buyer-runtime registry. Native web + recurring crypto-agent x402 tools settle in USDC on Base. Designed for operator-installed funded runtimes with explicit spend caps.

tools.name: url_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert a public webpage URL to clean Markdown for RAG, grounding, research, summarization and LLM context.

max_chars.description: Maximum Markdown characters to return, up to 150000.

tools.name: monitor_webpage
tools.description: Detect meaningful webpage changes for prices, inventory, availability, documentation, policies and competitor monitoring. For recurring checks, pass the prior response current_hash back as previous_hash.

previous_hash.description: Prior deterministic hash from the preceding successful check.

previous_text.description: Optional prior text for diff generation.

include_current_text.description: Include current normalized text in the response.

tools.name: extract_web_metadata
tools.description: Extract title, description, canonical URL, robots directives, headings, OpenGraph, Twitter cards and JSON-LD for one public URL.

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: Return native ETH and USDC balances for one wallet on Base or Ethereum.

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain id; eip155:8453 for Base or eip155:1 for Ethereum.

tools.name: monitor_wallet
tools.description: Recurring wallet monitor: check ETH/token balances and new USDC/ERC-20 transfers since the prior cursor. Returns next_cursor and current_state_hash for the next scheduled call.

network.description: base or ethereum; defaults to base.

activity_contract.description: ERC-20 activity contract; defaults to USDC.

lookback_blocks.description: Initial scan lookback, up to 5000 blocks.

previous_state_hash.description: Prior state hash for change detection.

tools.name: treasury_snapshot
tools.description: One-call treasury snapshot: ETH and ERC-20 balances, gas/base fee and recent USDC/ERC-20 activity with cursor and state hash for recurring polling.

network.description: base or ethereum; defaults to base.

activity_contract.description: ERC-20 activity contract; defaults to USDC.

lookback_blocks.description: Initial scan lookback, up to 5000 blocks.

previous_state_hash.description: Prior state hash for change detection.

tools.name: pretrade_context
tools.description: Pre-trade data bundle for crypto agents: wallet balances, ERC-20 allowance, current gas/base fee, realtime price, 24h stats and best bid/ask. Data-only; never submits a trade.

network.description: base or ethereum; defaults to base.

tools.name: watch_transaction
tools.description: Poll an EVM transaction until confirmed or reverted. Returns confirmations, current_state_hash and next-check state for recurring confirmation workflows.

network.description: base or ethereum; defaults to base.

previous_state_hash.description: Prior state hash for detecting status changes.
